title: Transcription
description: A gene is read off the DNA into a working copy, messenger RNA, to be carried out to the ribosomes. Unlocks the Ribosome Assembler and Messenger RNA.

puzzle.goal: RNA polymerase takes s seconds to settle on a gene, then copies g bases a second. Write how long, t, it takes to copy a gene of L bases.
puzzle.name: Transcription time
puzzle.ask: Find t for s = @{s}, L = @{L} and g = @{g}.
puzzle.method: A wait to start, then one base at a time at a steady speed: length over speed.
